hooks.command: OTHERS=$(bash .claude/sessions.sh register | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//'); if [ -n "$OTHERS" ]; then echo "Take a worktree before your first edit."; echo "Note: other Claude sessions are live in this checkout right now ($OTHERS), so working here directly risks mixing edits with theirs. Two incidents are behind this: two sessions once produced committed figures built against uncommitted edits, and a broad 'git add' once swept another session's in-flight edits into an unrelated commit. Offer to work in a worktree on a new branch (EnterWorktree) so edits cannot mix. A commit in this checkout will be refused while more than one session is live; the hook says how."; elif [ "$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)" = "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Note: this is the only live session in this checkout right now. Work on main. Commit and push when a full 'bash run.sh' passes; if the push is rejected because someone else pushed first, pull, run 'bash run.sh' again, then push. Explain any git step in plain words."; fi; true
